name: Therapy Session Note (SOAP)
description: Talk-therapy / counseling session note in SOAP format, focused on themes and progress rather than medication management.

sections.title: Session Metadata
sections.instruction: Client initials/ID, session date, provider, session number or type, duration (HIPAA-sensitive, no full names)

sections.title: Subjective (S)
sections.instruction: Client's self-reported mood, concerns, and updates since the last session

sections.title: Objective (O)
sections.instruction: Observed affect, engagement, and behavior during the session

sections.title: Assessment (A)
sections.instruction: Clinical impression, themes explored, and progress toward therapy goals

sections.title: Plan (P)
sections.instruction: Therapeutic approach used and next steps

sections.title: Coping Strategies & Homework
sections.instruction: Techniques or exercises assigned between sessions

sections.title: Next Appointment
sections.instruction: Date, time, and modality of next session
